style: Art-rock and angular post-punk ensemble with dry close-miked drums, prepared electric bass, and metallic percussion. Harmony system: modal drone harmony with shifting scale-degree emphasis, bitonal layers that retain separate tonal centers, and blues-dominant chromatic side-steps. Melodic system: angular punk phrasing with narrow repetitive cells, chromatic cabaret patter that suddenly opens into sustained falsetto vowels, and hocketed fragments. Rhythmic system: asymmetric Balkan meter invaded by motorik pulse, deep funk syncopation, and abrupt hard silence interruptions. Timbre: dry organic room bleed, abrasive tape saturation, and prepared piano clatter. Performance attitude: theatrical overstatement played completely straight, hyper-articulate nervous energy. lyrics:
[Instrumentation: Dry close-miked drums, prepared electric bass, metallic percussion, and prepared piano]
[Tempo: 136 BPM, asymmetric meter with periodic motorik interruptions]
[Lead Vocal: Hyper-articulate nervous delivery with dry deadpan narration]
[Support Vocals: Stacked close-harmony counterpoint with hocketed fragments]

[Verse 1]
We take the central office chair
And classify it as a large migratory pelican.
We observe its migration patterns across the linoleum
And measure its wingspan in centimeters of mahogany.
Is it not obvious from the curved wooden back
And the feathered accumulation of dust upon the cushion
That this creature belongs to the genus Pelecanus?
We must recompile the administrative handbook
To account for avian nesting habits in cubicle four.
It builds a complex nest from discarded inter-office memos
And incubates a clutch of white-out correction tape rollers.
We watch it preen its armrests with oily bureaucratic secretions.
It nests upon the filing cabinets, guarding its clutch of paperweights.

[Chorus]
[Kinetic Density Increase]
[Call-and-Response: Massed voices answering single dry lead]
Classify the furniture as fauna!
Migrate the database to the coastal shallows!
We observe the flightless specimen resting near the water cooler!
It dips its beak into the typing pool!
Swallow the ledger whole and regurgitate the fiscal surplus!
Let the migratory chair take flight above the fluorescent lights!
And sweep the audit trail into the ocean currents!

[Verse 2]
[Substrate Smuggler Activation: Causal skeleton transferred to marine biology domain]
The problem of the delayed quarterly report
Is structurally identical to the buoyancy crisis of a sinking whale.
We strip away the spreadsheets and apply deep-sea pressure:
The balance sheet is blubber; the executive summary is a dorsal fin.
We tow the accounting department into the Marianas Trench
And let tectonic plate subduction solve the overhead costs.
The structural invariant remains intact:
If it does not float, it must be harpooned by audit.
The shareholders scream beneath ten thousand fathoms of brine
While lanternfish illuminate our double-entry bookkeeping.
The hydrothermal vents provide sufficient warmth for the annual tax return.

[Bridge]
[Root Surgeon Activation: Dependency graph recompilation]
Remove the primitive concept of linear time.
Replace it with recursive crustacean molting.
Every dependent meeting, deadline, and coffee break
Is now recompiled under shell growth mechanics.
You do not schedule an appointment;
You shed your carapace and wait for the new calcium.
Unrelated concepts like the cafeteria menu remain untouched;
Everything else calcifies into an externalized exoskeleton.
We measure progress by the thickness of our chitin plates
And defend our quarterly projections with snapping claws and eyestalks.
The board of directors scuttles sideways across the boardroom floor.

[Guitar Interlude: Angular post-punk arpeggios with metallic percussion stabs]

[Verse 3]
[Stemminess Exposure: Isolated bassline and dry vocal exposed]
The pelican chair migrates south for the fiscal year.
We observe it nesting in the photocopier.
It regurgitates paperclips to feed its young.
The taxonomic error is now official municipal law.
Do not attempt to sit upon the bird.
It bites with a beak made of laminated particle board.
Its feathers are rustling sheets of carbon copy paper
And its eyes are gleaming brass upholstery tacks.
We track its migration from the watercooler up into the drop ceiling tiles.
It leaves behind a trail of pristine white feathers made of fax paper.
Its territorial calls echo through the ventilation shafts like ringing telephones.

[Chorus]
[Full Ensemble Return with High Kinetic Density]
Classify the furniture as fauna!
Migrate the database to the coastal shallows!
We observe the flightless specimen resting near the water cooler!
It dips its beak into the typing pool!
Swallow the ledger whole and regurgitate the fiscal surplus!
Let the migratory chair take flight above the fluorescent lights!
And sweep the audit trail into the ocean currents!

[Outro]
[Abrupt Silence Interruption]
[Dry spoken voice]
The classification is complete.
The chair has flown away through the drop ceiling.
Only a pile of shredded documents remains upon the carpet.
[Single prepared piano chord ringing out into dry room bleed]
[End]
caption: An angular post-punk and art-rock track governed by the Taxonomy Goblin, Substrate Smuggler, and Root Surgeon minds. It classifies office furniture as migratory pelicans, compresses financial problems into whale buoyancy mechanics, and recompiles time around crustacean molting. Featuring dry close-miked drums, prepared electric bass, hocketed vocal counterpoint, bitonal harmony, and sudden structural silence interruptions that heighten the absurd bureaucratic narrative throughout every movement
